desc: The U526 is a purpose-built 16-inch duty rifle engineered for shooters who value smooth recoil, consistency, and long-term reliability. Its intermediate gas system and hybrid-profile, chrome-lined barrel work together to deliver a refined shooting impulse across a wide range of ammunition. Designed as a complete system — not a parts-bin assembly — the U526 balances accuracy, durability, and control in a lightweight, hard-use configuration. This is a rifle built to run predictably when conditions and expectations are high.
